title: Pablo is an excellent guide, would highly recommend.
text: Pablo is an excellent guide who speaks fluent English honed in New York. He has a comprehensive knowledge of the Alhambra and Granada and an obvious love for it. The time flew by with one wonder after another. Would highly recommend.

title: A memorable vist with an excellent guide
text:
We visited the Alhambra as a group of 20 people from different countries, and it was one of the highlights of our trip.

Our guide Alicia, a local, was knowledgeable and experienced — no small thing when managing a large group through such a busy site. She kept things moving smoothly and made sure everyone got something out of the visit. She also shared useful tips on what to explore independently afterwards, since the ticket covers the full day.

Highly recommended.
author: Jhjohanson1

title: L Alhambra with Carina, 3 hours unforgettable!!!
text: Hello, I recommend Carina for this guided tour. Not only does Carina speak perfect French and she is very professional and knowledgeable on the site is equal to her motivation and joy and good humor. You will have a great time, full of humor and good humor with very delicate and subtle feminist accents. Thank you Carina for this moment of sharing and great tolerance. See you soon for a next visit with other friends. Corinne, Gerard, Sandra and Laurent of Corsica
